summary.online_feedback: Frozen PHYSICAL response only; internal/dual indicators are offline diagnostics.
summary.limits: Six images per dataset, shared across tasks, one seed: twelve image clusters. No retuning of response rule, ridge or source time table. Target-task time uses five OTHER images without quality labels and incurs calibration-data cost. Frozen-source prediction is transfer; target-task LOIO is exploratory diagnostic, not transfer or an online controller. Native exact-adjoint/unit-domain local references; new protocol versus historical legacy SR. Last-unroll feedback only; no full-ten-epoch feedback, step changes, NFE saving, convergence or global generalization. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive, unadjusted, approximate.
summary.source_scope: Frozen physical response rule upper2/deadband.01, source time table and A39 feature definitions. Twelve unused images within accessible history, reused across two tasks; one seed. New exact-adjoint/unit-domain matched C in all four groups, not historical legacy SR baseline. Original first270; only last30 guidance changes. Target-task time is leave-one-image-out unlabeled task calibration; frozen source time is zero-target-calibration. No PI online control, regularizer, hyperparameter scan, step/schedule or NFE-saving claim.
summary.task_time_calibration: Other five images/condition require state trajectories; not a free standalone300-NFE method. All acquisition/replay costs above; no end-to-end speed claim.

baseline_context.interpretation: Naive is bicubic observation upsampling for SR, noisy observation for blur. A weak matched C limits practical quality claims even if STATE-C is positive.
